_what_this_is: The SDK floor and the test-runner mode. Neither entry is a pin. The version below is a FLOOR with rollForward=latestMajor, which takes the newest installed SDK and fails loudly on a machine that is behind -- the opposite of a ceiling. See STACK.md, 'The build configuration'.
_the_test_entry_is_not_a_version: TUnit is MTP-only. The MTP mode of 'dotnet test' is opted into here and nowhere else (.NET 10 SDK and later; Microsoft Learn, looked up 2026-08-16). Without it 'dotnet test' runs the VSTest path and errors out against an MTP v2 test project.
_provenance: Floor recorded 2026-08-16 against the SDK installed on this machine (10.0.302, dotnet --list-sdks). Raising it is a decision; a machine with a newer SDK needs no change here, because rollForward already takes it.
